content.rendered: It is once again that time to order your student grade level school supply kits for next year.  Click Here to go to the on-line ordering site.  Ridges Account number is 22627.  This ordering site will be available for families to order their grade level school supply kits until Friday, June 23rd.  The kits will be delivered to the school and will be placed on student desks for Supply Night.   Parents are also welcome to purchase their students’ supplies on their own, Click Here to view the Ridges Supply List for the 2023-24 school year.  If there are any families that need financial assistance purchasing school supplies, please reach out to Miranda Johnson, our Principal at mmjohnson@sherwood.k12.or.us.   Thank you.
